name: Vintage Stout 2024 - Pōkeno Whisky Barrel Aged
notes: The 2024 Vintage Stout is the sixth release of our ‘Vintage’ range of yearly Barrel Aged releases. This Imperial Stout was brewed with a ‘Reiterated’ Double Mashing schedule, in which the second mash is mixed in with high gravity Wort from the first mash. This process allows us to extract a more concentrated sweet Wort, which feeds the yeast to create a higher alcohol brew. A small addition of dextrose sugar in the fermenter added an extra hit of alcohol which gives this beer a warming balance to the oak tannins. We then decanted the beer into New Zealand Whisky Barrels from Pōkeno Distillery, and left the beer to rest for nine months. The process of Oak ageing creates a chemical reaction between the wood and the beer, in which flavour compounds such as tannins and vanillins leach into the beer, creating a rounded and complex flavour. By treating the oak barrel as an additional ‘ingredient’ we’ve been able to create this complex and rich brew that is perfect for winter nights, and will also cellar extremely well as it gains complexity with ageing.

name: Gisborne Black Milk Stout
notes: A very moreish and drinkable milk stout, with smooth chocolate, rich malt flavours with an underlying milk creaminess. A perfect session worthy stout!

name: Gisborne Gold
notes: This is still NZ's longest running craft lager in the country. 34 years of Gisborne Gold, has supreme champion status, multiple gold medals, and a true cult following. NZBA 2025 SILVER MEDAL

name: Imperial Brown Ale
notes: Aged in ex-port and Pinot Noir barrels for 8 months before blending. Hazelnuts, vanilla, and cocoa nib additions blend together with rich caramel, toffee, and chocolate notes imparted by the malts. This beer has been aging at the brewery for 4 years and now shows great nutty, vinous and vanilla notes.

name: Les Hopserables
notes: A West Coast IPA with a Broadway-sized cast of classic hops. Chinook, Citra, Centennial and Simcoe take centre stage, delivering bright citrus, pine, and dank resin over a crisp, dry finish. Brewed by Sunshine and Three Sisters for the Malthouse WCIPA Challenge, this is a tale of bold bitterness, big aroma and hop redemption. Sing it loud: do you hear the hops sing?

name: Sea Fog Hazy IPA
notes: This easy-going Hazy Pale Ale is like drinking a bowl of ripe summer fruit. It's packed with soft juicy peach and sweet apricot, rounded out by bright citrus zest. Because it's lighter at 4.9, it feels incredibly approachable and sessionable - perfect for hanging out on the patio. Expect a fluffy, hazy texture and a gentle, fruity sweetness that keeps you coming back for another sip.

name: Brewing Spotlight No IV
notes: Festival Release Once off Pale Ale

name: Dubh X Oatmeal Milk Stout
notes: Velvety mouthfeel with chocolate and coffee notes.

name: Fizz Pop and Hop
notes: Ingredients: * VAI Vodka * Lemongrass syrup * Cranberry juice * Lemon/Lime Juice * Mango hop foam * The most Instagrammable/TikTok-worthy cocktail you will see at Beervana . Flavours that are zingy, hoppy, sweet, and balanced citrusy that it'll make your mind POP . Also available ‘guilt free’ (non-alc) in case you’ve had too many beersie.

name: Fizz Pop and Hop - NON ALC
Koko (Espresso) Martini
notes: Ingredients: * VAI Vodka * Koko Samoa * Koko Liqueur * Green bullet (hop) syrup * Chocolate-drizzled marshmallows (garnish) * Consider your standard espresso martini officially retired. We brought the real deal straight from Samoa, teaming up authentic Koko Samoa and Koko Liqueur with VAI Vodka . Finished with chocolate-drizzled marshmallows, this is sweet, rich, and straight-up paradise in a glass .

name: Monkey Colada a.k.a. Ohh, Ahh, Umaga
notes: Ingredients: * Dancing Sands Coconut & Vanilla Rum * Coconut Water * Coconut Milk * Coconut syrup * Spiced Pineapple and Hop Juice * If you can't escape to Fiji for a holiday, then we will bring the holiday in Fiji to you, but in your cup . Creamy, smooth, fruity and fresh, just what you need after another heavy hopped IPA . Also available ‘guilt free’ (non-alc) in case you are the responsible adult .

name: Monkey Colada a.k.a. Ohh, Ahh, Umaga (NON ALC)
Pacific Dark & Stormy
notes: Ingredients: * Dancing Sands Coconut & Vanilla Rum * Ginger Hop Soda * Lemon * Angostura Bitters * Ginger and spice and everything nice with a good splash of Dancing Sands Coconut & Vanilla Rum . Having the Pacific Dark & Stormy 'guilt free' (non-alc) is just as delicious .

name: Roxy Rosebud
notes: Ingredients: * VAI Vodka * Cranberry and Pineapple juice * Passionfruit * Lemon Juice * Vanilla Green bullet (hop) syrup * It's a ROSEBUD made by the #RW team from ROXY and infused with HOPS , literally the most delicious non-beer beverage your palate will enjoy. Only thing that could be better is fried chicken... unless you’re vegetarian . Also available ‘guilt free’ (non-alc) in case your Beervana allowance is running low .

name: The Bling Blossom
notes: Ingredients: * VAI Vodka * Sparkling Fresh Green Apple hoppy Juice * Lime * Triple Berry bubbles * Bling Bling Coaster * Get ready to glow! This bad boy mixes VAI vodka with zingy sparkling green apple and a splash of lime . Topped with fluffy, vibrant triple berry bubbles, it's basically a party in a glass . Oh, and did we mention it sits on a Bling Bling Coaster that lights up?! Seriously insta-worthy, super refreshing, and just a whole lotta fun. Wanna keep it chill? Grab the non-alc version!

name: Big Pink Energy
style: Watermelon and Passionfruit Ice Cream Smoothie Sour
notes: A bright pink smoothie sour loaded with watermelon, passionfruit and banana, then softened with vanilla ice cream for a creamy, juicy finish. Big Pink Energy is fruity, tangy and a little bit ridiculous — like a watermelon sundae with main character confidence.

name: Dragonfruit Smoothie
notes: Dragonfruit, banana and vanilla come together in this bright, creamy smoothie sour. Dragonfruit Smoothie is juicy, tangy and wildly pink — soft, tropical and just weird enough to keep things interesting.

name: Fuzzy Panda
notes: A juicy Hazy Pale Ale with Cryo Mosaic, Citra, and Motueka, double dry hopped, Maris Otter malt base with oats and wheat…things might get fuzzy!

name: Oakura Blonde
notes: Classic Blonde Ale, easy drinker

name: Papaya Don't Preach
style: Papaya, Coconut, Mango Ice Cream Smoothie Sour
notes: Mango, papaya and banana get the full tropical treatment with coconut and vanilla ice cream in this thick, creamy smoothie sour. Papaya Don’t Preach is soft, golden and gently tangy — all fruit, all fluff, no judgment.

name: Rain In The Face
notes: One of the original beers to come out of Three Sisters and the start of the journey. Big in your face American Pale Ale, double dry hopped, Chinook and Simcoe come together on a generous base of Maris Otter malts.

name: So Much Noise
notes: A big, bold beer that's citrusy with lime and grapefruit notes. It's mildly sweet and full-bodied with a juicy, fruity finish. Strong but surprisingly drinkable for its size.

name: Interstellar
notes: Citra, Amarillo and Motueka hops giving citrus and stonefruit hop flavour balanced with a nutty malt base. Moderate bitterness.

name: Nitro Espresso Stoutini
notes: Roasted coffee and chocolate notes with a hint of vanilla sweetness. Served on nitro to give a smooth velvet body.

brewery: Good George Distilling x Pink Boots NZ
name: Boots N Soda
notes: Combining all that is GOOD! Pink Boots and Good George Distilling Lemon Myrtle, Makrut Lime Leaf and Rosemary gin is paired with a classic soda. Think Citrus Bomb without all the fruit getting in the way.

name: Karma Cola Sour
notes: Karma Cola Sour

name: Salted Caramel Stout
notes: Rich, creamy and velvety with layered notes of caramel, coffee and roasted malts balanced by a delicate saline edge that lingers on the finish. Decadent yet well-rounded and full-bodied from the addition of oats to the grain bill, this beer is full-flavoured and delicious - the perfect mid-winter treat.

name: Barrel Aged Imperial IPA
notes: An Imperial IPA brewed with generous New Zealand malts, then aged for 18 months in Chardonnay barrels from INVIVO Winery. Elegant barrel aromatics, delicate acidity, and rounded richness come together in layered harmony.

name: ChaChaCha
notes: Captured the delicate "umami" of Japanese green tea in a beer. Blending three carefully selected teas and using an optimal cold-steeping method, we bring out deep umami and a lingering finish. Brewed clean and simple, with gentle malt and hops that elevate the elegance of the tea. Japanese green tea takes the spotlight.

name: GOHOBI
notes: Brewed in Japan by Japanese brewer Kengo Saito, who learned his craft here in Wellington, this NZ IPA is a homecoming of sorts. Bright and citrus-forward, with vibrant aromas of orange and grapefruit layered over the fresh, green character of New Zealand hops. Tropical yeast notes add depth, leading to a flavorful, refreshing IPA with a clean and satisfying finish. Born from Kengo’s time in Wellington, brewed in Yokohama, and now back in New Zealand.

name: KAIZOKU
notes: A bold lager that captures the essence of Japanese "umami". Inspired by the clarity and refinement of Japanese cuisine, this lager delivers a light, smooth drinking experience with a deep sense of umami.

name: TORIAEZU
notes: Featuring the fresh and vibrant aroma of NZ Riwaka hops, the refined character of sake yeast, and the rich umami of traditional Japanese ingredients such as Kombu kelp, Shiitake mashroom, and bonito flakes bring depth and lasting complexity.

name: UTSUROI
notes: UTSUROI deliberately brings the ginjo-like aromatics of sake yeast to the forefront. The aroma is reminiscent of Japanese sake, with expressive notes of ripe melon and pear. Rice koji, polished rice bran, and wasanbon sugar contribute soft, layered umami, giving the beer a delicate yet complex depth. To further explore umami as a defining element of Japanese food culture, we also used Kombu kelp, bonito flakes, and Shiitake mushrooms. The result is a clean, refined beer with a quiet, savoury finish that continues to unfold long after each sip.
